description: Source code implementing ubus support for hostapd, including functions for managing ubus connections, notifying events, handling BSS and client management, and various Wi-Fi related operations within the hostapd project.

methods.name: get_hapd_from_object
methods.description: Retrieves hostapd data structure from ubus object.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_ref_dec
methods.description: Decrements ubus context reference count and frees if zero.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_add_bss
methods.description: Adds a hostapd BSS object to ubus.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_free_bss
methods.description: Removes a hostapd BSS object from ubus.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_handle_event
methods.description: Handles incoming ubus events related to frames and reports.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_notify
methods.description: Sends a notification to ubus subscribers.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_notify_radar_detected
methods.description: Notifies ubus about radar detection events.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_notify_bss_transition_response
methods.description: Notifies ubus about BSS transition responses.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_notify_apup_newpeer
methods.description: Notifies ubus about new peer in APUP.

methods.name: hostapd_ubus_notify_csa
methods.description: Notifies ubus about channel switch announcement.
